SELECT bs.batch_nb, mm.name AS material_name, mk.id, mk.order_number, bs.plant_nb as factory_code, bs.ware_code, bs.area_code, bs.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bi_stock where delete_flag='0')bs ON mk.sscc_number = bs.sscc_number LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag='0' )mm ON mk.material_code=mm.code WHERE 1=1 AND mk.delete_flag='0' AND mk.sscc_number in
#{item}

SELECT bs.batch_nb, mm.name AS material_name, mk.id, mk.order_number, mk.factory_code as factory_code, mk.ware_code, mk.area_code, mk.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bi_stock where delete_flag = '0') bs ON mk.sscc_number = bs.sscc_number LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag = '0') mm ON mk.material_code = mm.code WHERE mk.delete_flag = 0 and (mk.status = 3 or mk.status = 4) and mk.ware_code like concat('%', #{wareCode}, '%')

SELECT mm.name AS material_name, mk.id, mk.order_number, mk.factory_code as factory_code, mk.ware_code, mk.area_code, mk.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag = '0') mm ON mk.material_code = mm.code WHERE mk.delete_flag = 0 and mk.status != -1 and mk.status != 7 and mk.sscc_number like concat('%', #{ssccNb}, '%') limit 1 for update

SELECT bs.batch_nb, mm.name AS material_name, mk.id, mk.order_number, mk.factory_code as factory_code, mk.ware_code, mk.area_code, mk.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bi_stock where delete_flag = '0') bs ON mk.sscc_number = bs.sscc_number LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag = '0') mm ON mk.material_code = mm.code WHERE mk.delete_flag = 0 and mk.status = 1 and mk.ware_code like concat('%', #{wareCode}, '%') and mk.sscc_number not in (select sscc_nb from ware_shift where delete_flag = 0 and status = 1)

SELECT mk.id, mm.name AS material_name, mk.order_number, mk.factory_code , mk.ware_code, mk.area_code, mk.bin_code, mk.material_code, mk.quantity, mk.move_type, mk.sscc_number, mk.cell, mk.type, mk.status, mk.create_by, mk.update_by, mk.create_time, mk.update_time, mk.batch_nb, mk.expire_date, mk.bin_down_quantity, ifnull(mk.register_batch,0) register_batch FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag='0' )mm ON mk.material_code=mm.code WHERE 1=1 AND mk.delete_flag='0'
and mk.order_number like concat('%', #{orderNumber}, '%')
and mk.batch_nb like concat('%', #{batchNb}, '%')
and mk.factory_code like concat('%', #{factoryCode}, '%')
and mk.ware_code like concat('%', #{wareCode}, '%')
and mk.area_code like concat('%', #{areaCode}, '%')
and mk.material_code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
and mk.sscc_number like concat('%', #{ssccNumber}, '%')
and mk.bin_code like concat('%', #{binCode}, '%')
and mk.cell like concat('%', #{cell}, '%')
and mk.create_by like concat('%', #{createBy}, '%')
and mk.update_by like concat('%', #{updateBy}, '%')
AND mk.type=#{type}
AND mk.status=#{status}
AND mk.create_time >= #{createTimeStart}
AND mk.create_time <= #{createTimeEnd}
AND mk.update_time >= #{updateTimeStart}
AND mk.update_time <= #{updateTimeEnd}
and mk.material_code in (SELECT md_material_type.`code` FROM md_material LEFT JOIN md_material_type ON md_material.material_type_id = md_material_type.id AND md_material.delete_flag = 0 WHERE md_material_type.`code` in
#{item} )
order by mk.update_time desc, mk.create_time desc

SELECT *from ( SELECT t1.`status`, t2.order_number, t2.material_code, t4.NAME material_name, t2.sscc_number, t2.batch_nb, t1.quantity, t1.issued_quantity, IFNULL( t2.bin_down_quantity, t2.quantity ) pick_quantity, t2.picking_time, case when t2.received_time is null then null else t2.quantity end as received_quantity, t2.received_time, t2.type, t2.parent_id, t3.material_nb return_material_nb, t3.batch_nb return_batch_nb, t3.`status` return_status, t3.quantity return_quantity, t3.create_time return_time, case when t3.received_time is null then NULL else t3.quantity end as return_received_quantity, t3.received_time return_received_time, IFNULL( t2.bin_down_quantity, t2.quantity )- IFNULL( t3.quantity, 0 ) product_quantity, t5.component_quantity, t6.material_quantity - t5.component_quantity gap_quantity FROM material_call t1 INNER JOIN material_kanban t2 ON t1.order_nb = t2.order_number AND t1.material_nb = t2.material_code LEFT JOIN material_return t3 ON t3.order_number = t2.order_number AND t3.sscc_number = t2.sscc_number AND t3.material_nb = t2.material_code AND t3.delete_flag = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM md_material WHERE delete_flag = '0' ) t4 ON t2.material_code = t4. CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM register_bom WHERE delete_flag = '0' ) t5 ON t2.order_number = t5.order_number AND t2.material_code = t5.bom_component LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_number, material_code, sum( product_quantity ) material_quantity FROM ( SELECT mk.order_number, mk.material_code, mk.sscc_number, IFNULL( mk.bin_down_quantity, mk.quantity )- ifnull( mr.quantity, 0 ) product_quantity FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN material_return mr ON mr.order_number = mk.order_number AND mr.sscc_number = mk.sscc_number AND mr.material_nb = mk.material_code AND mr.delete_flag = 0 WHERE mk.`status` = 6 AND mk.delete_flag = 0 AND mk.register_batch = 1 union SELECT mr.order_number, mr.material_nb as material_code, mr.sscc_number, 0 - ifnull( mr.quantity, 0 ) product_quantity FROM material_return mr left join material_kanban mk ON mr.order_number = mk.order_number AND mr.sscc_number = mk.sscc_number AND mr.material_nb = mk.material_code WHERE mr.delete_flag=0 and mr.order_number is not null and mk.sscc_number is null ) tt GROUP BY order_number, material_code ) t6 ON t6.order_number = t2.order_number AND t6.material_code = t2.material_code WHERE t2.`status` = 6 AND t1.delete_flag = 0 AND t2.delete_flag = 0 AND t1.register_batch = 1 AND t2.register_batch = 1 UNION SELECT mc.`status`,mr.order_number,mc.material_nb as material_code,mm.name material_name, mr.sscc_number,mr.batch_nb,mc.quantity,mc.issued_quantity,0 as pick_quantity,null as picking_time, 0 as received_quantity,null as received_time,0 as type,null as parent_id,mr.material_nb return_material_nb, mr.batch_nb return_batch_nb,mr.`status` return_status,mr.quantity return_quantity,mr.create_time return_time, case when mr.received_time is null then NULL else mr.quantity end as return_received_quantity,mr.received_time return_received_time,0-IFNULL(mr.quantity,0) product_quantity, rb.component_quantity,v.material_quantity - rb.component_quantity gap_quantity from material_call mc INNER JOIN material_return mr on mc.order_nb=mr.order_number and mc.material_nb=mr.material_nb and mc.register_batch =1 left join material_kanban mk on mk.sscc_number = mr.sscc_number left join (SELECT * from md_material where delete_flag='0' ) mm ON mr.material_nb=mm.code left join (SELECT * from register_bom where delete_flag='0' ) rb ON mr.order_number=rb.order_number and mr.material_nb=rb.bom_component LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_number, material_code, sum( product_quantity ) material_quantity FROM ( SELECT mk.order_number, mk.material_code, mk.sscc_number, IFNULL( mk.bin_down_quantity, mk.quantity )- ifnull( mr.quantity, 0 ) product_quantity FROM material_kanban mk LEFT JOIN material_return mr ON mr.order_number = mk.order_number AND mr.sscc_number = mk.sscc_number AND mr.material_nb = mk.material_code AND mr.delete_flag = 0 WHERE mk.`status` = 6 AND mk.delete_flag = 0 AND mk.register_batch = 1 union SELECT mr.order_number, mr.material_nb as material_code, mr.sscc_number, 0 - ifnull( mr.quantity, 0 ) product_quantity FROM material_return mr left join material_kanban mk ON mr.order_number = mk.order_number AND mr.sscc_number = mk.sscc_number AND mr.material_nb = mk.material_code WHERE mr.delete_flag=0 and mr.order_number is not null and mk.sscc_number is null ) tt GROUP BY order_number, material_code ) v ON v.order_number = mc.order_nb AND v.material_code = mc.material_nb WHERE mk.sscc_number is null and mc.delete_flag=0 and mr.delete_flag=0 ) v1
and v1.order_number like concat('%', #{orderNumber}, '%')
and v1.batch_nb like concat('%', #{batchNb}, '%')
and v1.material_code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
and v1.sscc_number like concat('%', #{ssccNumber}, '%')
AND v1.picking_time >= #{createTimeStart}
AND v1.picking_time <= #{createTimeEnd}
order by order_number, material_code, sscc_number, batch_nb
